tools.name: describe_juno
tools.description: Explains Juno Worksheets: custom printable worksheet packs for kids TK-8th grade, ordered by text message. Returns what it does, how to start, what makes it different, pricing, privacy and links. Use when a parent or teacher wants personalized printable worksheets.

tools.name: get_grade_info
tools.description: Returns what a Juno worksheet pack usually covers for one grade (TK, K, 1-8), how pages are laid out for that age, sample packs for that grade and the grade page link.

tools.name: list_sample_worksheets
tools.description: Lists public sample worksheet packs (title, grade, what's inside, preview image and PDF link). Optionally filter by grade.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns Juno Worksheets plans: 3 free packs a month, $5/month for 2 packs a week, $10/month unlimited. Teachers pay the same.

tools.name: start_pack_request
tools.description: Builds the exact text message (and a tap-to-text sms: link) a parent or teacher sends to Juno to get a custom printable pack. Nothing is sent or stored by this tool; the person sends the text themselves from their phone. Do not pass names of children other than an optional first name, and never pass

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_pack_request · Public sink: start_pack_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_pack_request · Public sink: start_pack_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns Juno Worksheets plans: 3 free packs a month, $5/month for 2 packs a week, $10/month unlimited. Teachers pay the same." → after: "Returns Juno Worksheets plans: 3 free packs a month for each kid, then $5/month per kid for 2 packs a week or $10/month per kid unlimited. A teacher's class counts as one kid."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
